# Configure agents, providers and machine settings `CAP`

[As built](../README.md) › Configure agents, providers and machine settings

As built at `4b8570d19ee1`, read 2026-10-07.

Lets a user assign which provider serves each agent team, set thinking levels, manage provider credentials and routes, track resource usage, and set this machine's editor URL template, via screen:Agent configuration.
